request_state.conjecture_spec: Beal Conjecture: A^x + B^y = C^z with x,y,z >= 3 and gcd(A,B,C)=1
request_state.title: CONDUCTOR-COUPLED ARAKELOV-HODGE HYBRID (C293 + C300 + CONDUCTOR)
request_state.claim: Coupling the Lawrence-Venkatesh p-adic period map and Arakelov height bounds with the Frey curve Serre conductor N(rho_{E, p}) and minimal discriminant Delta = 2^(-8)*(A^x B^y C^z)^2 breaks projective invariance and resolves Failure Mode 5.
request_state.method: Minimal discriminant valuation val_q(Delta) and Serre wild conductor at 2, 3 and prime factors of gcd(A, B, C).

breaks_projective_invariance.instructions: Does the minimal discriminant Delta = 2^(-8)*(A^x B^y C^z)^2 and Serre level N(rho_{E,p}) break projective cross-ratio invariance, distinguishing coprime points gcd(A,B,C)=1 from projectively scaled triples?

criteria.true: Strictly breaks projective invariance; conductor depends on integer valuations, not projective cross-ratio.
criteria.false: Remains projectively invariant; cannot distinguish common factors.

resolves_failure_mode_5.instructions: Does this conductor-coupled invariant successfully resolve Failure Mode 5 (Moduli-Coprimality Conflation) identified in previous triage?

criteria.true: Resolves Failure Mode 5 by coupling geometric heights to arithmetic conductors.
criteria.false: Fails to resolve Failure Mode 5; still suffers from coprimality blindness.

mathematical_soundness.instructions: What is the mathematical validity of using conductor shift to separate primitive solutions?

criteria.unconditionally_sound: Unconditionally sound: minimal conductor and tame/wild Serre levels are integer invariants sensitive to common factors.
criteria.heuristic_dependent: Depends on unproved heuristics or conjectures.
criteria.conflation_error: Confuses geometric isogeny with Galois representation conductor.

formalizability_in_lean4.instructions: How feasible is formalizing the coprimality-to-discriminant valuation lemma in Lean 4 without sorry or custom axioms?

criteria.directly_formalizable: Directly formalizable via elementary algebra, valuation inequalities, and standard Mathlib.
criteria.requires_heavy_flt_machinery: Requires deep modularity or Galois representation machinery not in Mathlib.
criteria.unformalizable: Statement contains conceptual gaps that prevent formalization.
